title: DocToSpeech
description: Fully offline document-to-speech converter supporting 9 TTS models across 5 engine groups: Coqui (XTTS v2, Bark, VITS, YourTTS), StyleTTS 2, Resemble Chatterbox, Tortoise TTS, Sesame CSM-1B, and OpenVoice V2. Converts EPUB, PDF, DOCX, HTML, and TXT files to audio with voice cloning support. No API keys or cloud services required.
author: C0m3b4ck
